name: Text to image, 2048x2048, 40 steps
description: The same six prompts at 2048x2048, one of the checkpoint's published native 2K sizes. Four times the pixels of the 1K workload and roughly four times the latent tokens, so this is where attention cost and peak memory show up.
notes: Concurrency is 1 on purpose: one image at a time is the shape of a single-GPU box for this class of model, and a second request in flight measures the queue rather than the device. Each prompt is rendered `repeat` times and the median is reported, with `warmup_requests` rendered first and excluded. `guidance: null` means the lane's own default — guidance above 1 runs a second transformer forward per step, so a lane that silently defaults to 4 is doing twice the work of one that defaults to 1, and the value that was actually used belongs in the result's args. The size is native: it is what the checkpoint was trained at, not an upscale, and a lane that cannot hold it should record the OOM as the result.
